warning: Every label here is PROVISIONAL_CLAUDE_REVIEW and was authored by Claude Code. None of it is verified ground truth. No case may be used to certify a vision judge until independently approved. includeInMetrics is false throughout for that reason.
frameSampling: five deterministic points: edge-nudged start, 25%, 50%, 75%, edge-nudged end; edge = min(0.6s, 4% of duration) to skip leader/end cards

contactSheet.layout: 5 panels horizontal, labelled F1..F5 with timestamps
contactSheet.note: panel height is 180px; full-sheet target of 1600x900 was reduced to a single 1600x180 strip because five 320x180 panels tile horizontally

splitMethod: sha256('split-seed-v2:'+pexelsId), first hex char < '8' => calibration, else holdout; keyed on source id so duplicate clips cannot straddle the split
v1Note: tests/fixtures/visual-semantic-benchmark.v1.json is retained as a logic/requirements fixture. Its asset references are SYNTHETIC_DESCRIPTION_REFERENCE and it is NOT frame-backed.
